name: Komatsu Botan
source:
Botan absolutely loves sweets, to the point of wanting to eat them for all three meals, and she helps out many of the clubs because they offer her sweets as a reward. She adores [url=/c98231]Asuka[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
